_comment: Historical airspace overlays (Theater Identity pillar 3): real corridors, no-fly zones and deconfliction lines for a given map+era, drawn on the F10 Common draw layer + briefed on the kneeboard. INFORMATION, NOT ROUTING - no player waypoints. Geometry is lat/lon so it is projection-independent; the renderer (airspace.py) projects to map meters at build time. width_sm / radius_sm are STATUTE MILES (the historical unit for Berlin airspace). Coordinates for corridor terminals are curated approximations of the historical structure - tune against the in-game F10 map.

berlin_corridors.label: Berlin Air Corridors (BASC)
berlin_corridors.brief_title: BERLIN AIR CORRIDORS — BASC CONTROLLED AIRSPACE
brief: Three 20-statute-mile-wide corridors connect the West German air system to
West Berlin across GDR airspace, all terminating in the Berlin Control Zone.
Agreed by the Allied Control Authority ~30 Nov 1945; controlled by the four-
power Berlin Air Safety Centre (BASC, est. 12 Dec 1945). In force until the
BASC closed 31 Dec 1990 at reunification — a Cold-War feature only.
Ceiling 10,000 ft (raised to 13,000 ft at times for Soviet exercises).
RULE: remain WITHIN a corridor and BELOW the ceiling. Straying out of the
lateral or vertical limits over GDR territory risks interception. These are
drawn on the F10 map for reference — they are airspace, not a routed plan.
- NORTH  corridor: Hamburg (Bremen / Northern Europe) → Berlin
- BERLIN CONTROL ZONE: 20 sm radius over the city, all corridors converge.

euphrates_deconfliction.label: Euphrates Deconfliction Line
euphrates_deconfliction.brief_title: EUPHRATES DECONFLICTION LINE — US/RUSSIA FLIGHT-SAFETY MOU
brief: The Euphrates River valley is the de-facto deconfliction line between the
coalition (east of the river) and Russian/Syrian forces (west), under the
US-Russia flight-safety memorandum. It is a COORDINATION line, not a border.
RULE: coordinate before crossing; hold your side unless deconflicted. Drawn
on the F10 map (amber dashed) for reference — airspace, not a routed plan.
- Runs NW→SE: Turkish border → Raqqa → Deir ez-Zor → Abu Kamal (Iraq border).
